description: Write a pandas ETL script for fintech_app that incrementally loads ledger entries identified by a gapless sequence number entry_seq. The script should: (1) read last_loaded_seq from state (1000 in the sample), (2) read the batch file and keep entries with entry_seq > last_loaded_seq, (3) sort by entry_seq and load only the contiguous run starting at last_loaded_seq + 1; if a gap is found, stop before the gap, (4) parse amount strings to Decimal with 2 places (no float), (5) append the contiguous entries to the target, set last_loaded_seq to the last contiguous value, and write a gap report listing missing sequence numbers so the next run can retry.
edge_cases: Sequence 1003 is missing: entries 1004 and 1005 must not be loaded in this run, and the new last_loaded_seq is 1002
Entry 1000 was already loaded and must be ignored
The batch is not sorted; contiguity must be checked after sorting
Amounts must stay exact decimals: 10.10 parsed as float and summed produces drift
common_failure_modes: FM2: Advancing the watermark to max(entry_seq) = 1005 permanently skips entry 1003 when it arrives later
FM4: Float parsing of monetary amounts breaks exact debit/credit balancing
FM7: No gap detection or gap report
